ui package

Submodules

ui.gui module

Interactive Graphical User Interface (GUI) for Dyna-Q affective simulation.

Uses Pygame to visualize agent navigation, environment layouts, real-time Valence-Arousal emotion dynamics, a scrollable Q-table inspector with order sorting (State Ascending vs Recently Updated with green highlight), and an interactive Start/Pause control button.

ui.gui.run_gui_experiment(config: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]) → None

Run reinforcement learning simulation with an interactive Pygame GUI.

Features:

  • Animated agent navigation with physical collision recoil and shockwave on the grid.

  • Clickable Start/Pause control button.

  • Scrollable real-time Q-table inspector with dropdown sorting: * State (Ascending): Ordered by coordinate (0..N). * Recently Updated: State just updated immediately jumps to the top with green highlight.

  • Full display of all 4 short-term memory frequencies (f_col, f_dir, f_goal, f_right) and Core Affect (Valence & Arousal) for classic_va environment.

Parameters:

config (Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]) – Parsed configuration dictionary.

ui.headless module

Headless runner for reinforcement learning experiments.

Executes simulation benchmarks in the terminal without a GUI, manages multi-fixed seeds independently, logs training performance, and triggers image exports.

ui.renderer module

Environment rendering and image export utilities.

Provides functions to export publication-quality figures of generated gridworlds with obstacles, start, and goal positions, formatted for research papers.

ui.renderer.render_ascii_grid(grid: List[List[int]], start_pos: Tuple[int, int], goal_pos: Tuple[int, int], agent_pos: Tuple[int, int] | None = None) → str

Generate an ASCII string representation of the grid.

Parameters:

  • grid (List[List[int]]) – 2D grid matrix.

  • start_pos (Tuple[int, int]) – Start coordinate.

  • goal_pos (Tuple[int, int]) – Goal coordinate.

  • agent_pos (Optional[Tuple[int, int]], optional) – Agent’s current coordinate.

Returns:

Multi-line string representation of the grid.

Return type:

str

ui.renderer.resolve_env_image_path(reports_dir: str, experiment_name: str, generator_name: str, seed: int, save_in_experiment_dir: bool = True, group_name: str | None = None) → str

Resolve destination path for environment visualization image.

Parameters:

  • reports_dir (str) – Root reports directory.

  • experiment_name (str) – Experiment name from configuration.

  • generator_name (str) – Maze generator name (e.g. ‘kruskal’, ‘cellular_automata’).

  • seed (int) – Environment random seed.

  • save_in_experiment_dir (bool, optional) – If True, saves in reports/[group_name/]<experiment_name>/environment/seed_<seed>.png. If False, saves in reports/gridworld/<generator>/seed_<seed>.png. Defaults to True.

  • group_name (Optional[str], optional) – Optional group name grouping experiments.

Returns:

Absolute or relative file path for the environment image.

Return type:

str

ui.renderer.save_environment_image(grid: List[List[int]], start_pos: Tuple[int, int], goal_pos: Tuple[int, int], generator_name: str, seed: int, output_dir: str = 'reports', geodesic_distance: int | None = None, optimal_path: List[Tuple[int, int]] | None = None, dpi: int = 300, obstacle_color: Any | None = None, grid_line_color: Any | None = None, start_color: Any | None = None, goal_color: Any | None = None, save_path: str | None = None) → str

Save a publication-quality visual image matching research paper specifications.

Renders grid cells, obstacles, start (S), goal (G), shortest geodesic path, detailed subtitle metrics (obstacle percentage, distance), and a clean legend.

Parameters:

  • grid (List[List[int]]) – 2D grid matrix (0 for path, 1 for wall).

  • start_pos (Tuple[int, int]) – Start coordinate (row, col).

  • goal_pos (Tuple[int, int]) – Goal coordinate (row, col).

  • generator_name (str) – Name of the obstacle generator (‘kruskal’, ‘cellular_automata’).

  • seed (int) – Random seed used to generate the environment.

  • output_dir (str, optional) – Base directory for reports. Defaults to “reports”.

  • geodesic_distance (Optional[int], optional) – Length of maximum geodesic distance.

  • optimal_path (Optional[List[Tuple[int, int]]], optional) – Coordinate path for overlay.

  • dpi (int, optional) – Image resolution DPI. Defaults to 300.

  • obstacle_color (Optional[Any], optional) – Color for obstacle cells. Defaults to Dark Navy (40, 55, 71).

  • grid_line_color (Optional[Any], optional) – Color for grid divider lines. Defaults to (210, 210, 210).

  • start_color (Optional[Any], optional) – Color for start cell (S). Defaults to (46, 204, 113).

  • goal_color (Optional[Any], optional) – Color for goal cell (G). Defaults to (255, 140, 0).

  • save_path (Optional[str], optional) – Explicit destination path. If omitted, uses output_dir.

Returns:

Absolute or relative path to the generated image file.

Return type:

str
